name: Small test board (16-bit DDR4, 1 GiB)
_dsp: optional: DSP slices on the FPGA (needed by kernel_plan.py)
_lut_ff: optional: LUTs and flip-flops on the FPGA (kernel_plan.py then also keeps the kernel within them)
_clock_mhz: optional: kernel clock in MHz (kernel_plan.py assumes 50 when missing); 70 met timing on the board (vivado/build_v5)
_mem_gbps: optional: external memory bandwidth the kernel really gets, in GB/s. Measured streaming weights (2026-10-30): 3.42 with the DDR4 at 2666 MT/s (LLM_DDR4_TCK=750, vivado/build_v6; peak 5.33); 2.66 at the old 1600 MT/s (peak 3.2)
_max_ports: optional: how many weight ports (independent AXI connections to the memory) the kernel may use, 1 to 4; kernel_plan.py assumes 1 when missing
